area: Lyme Regis and Charmouth — a mile west of the Cobb to Stonebarrow

encoding.red: ground height: 0 = no data (usually sea); 1-254 = (red - 1) / 10 - 6 metres above Ordnance Datum; 255 = above 19.3 m, or land more than about 250 m from the sea (kept without detail)
encoding.blue: 3 = no survey data, Ordnance Survey foreshore, height ESTIMATED (red holds the estimate: a smooth slope from the surveyed beach down to mean low water at the sea's edge); 2 = OS foreshore, no survey data and no estimate: dries at low tide, height unknown; 0 otherwise (no-data outside the foreshore is sea)
encoding.foreshoreSource: Ordnance Survey OpenMap Local (Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right, OGL)

estimate.method: smoothest surface between the surveyed ground (kept within mean low..mean high water) and mean low water at the sea

landmask.meaning: white = land, black = sea or no data; covers the whole grid at the coarse spacing

source: Contains Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m), © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right, Open Government Licence v3.0
